supported_model_backends.purpose: offline default, tests and certification fixtures; not a language model

supported_model_backends.kind: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions API on a loopback address
configuration: in-app model setup (server URL and model, saved on this device)
supported_model_backends.model_selection: any model id the server lists; a named model must be installed (case and an implicit ':latest' tag are tolerated); when no model is named, the first model the server lists is used and reported as LOCAL_MODEL_AUTO_SELECTED
supported_model_backends.network_boundary: loopback addresses only; non-loopback URLs are refused before any request; environment proxies are bypassed

supported_model_backends.kind: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions API on another machine (LAN or hosted)
supported_model_backends.tested_protocol: GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions (stream and non-stream), optional Authorization: Bearer key
compatible_servers: Ollama or LM Studio on another host
supported_model_backends.gating: requires a configured server URL and allow_live=true per request; never selected implicitly; questions and source excerpts leave this device
supported_model_backends.network_boundary: explicit network exception; the API key is stored on this device in a 0600 file and is never returned by the API; plain http to a non-loopback host is flagged REMOTE_MODEL_CLEARTEXT_HTTP

supported_model_backends.gating: requires MUCARO_AI_LIVE_MODE=1, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and allow_live=true per request; never selected implicitly

supported_hardware_baseline.notes: Model weights are not bundled. Storage for weights depends on the model the user installs in their local server (for example about 5 GB for an 8B model at 4-bit quantization).

offline_capabilities: See `mucaro offline manifest` / GET /offline-manifest: ingestion, retrieval, cited answers (mock or local model), GIS, memory and exports work offline; web tools and the remote model require a network.
known_limitations: Mucaro does not ship or download model weights; a local model server must be installed and running for openai_compatible_local.
No claim of universal local-model compatibility: only the OpenAI-compatible chat-completions protocol subset above is exercised by tests.
Answer quality and citation compliance depend on the selected local model; uncited answers are flagged ERROR_UNCITED_ANSWER rather than accepted.

In chat, a message that matches no local source is answered by the selected model without evidence and marked NO_SOURCES_USED / WARN_NO_SOURCES_USED; it is never reported as CITATION_OK. The ask API and CLI stay strict and return ERROR_NO_RETRIEVAL_CONTEXT.

Models never run or approve tools. With the per-chat option on, a model served through the OpenAI-compatible providers may propose a call from a fixed catalogue (source_library.status, memory.list, web.search, web.fetch, coding.repo_status, coding.read_file, coding.diff); each proposal is an ordinary tool call requested_by=model that waits in the approval gate, and only local read-only tools are pre-approved in Auto mode. Tool output returns to the model as fenced untrusted data. Anthropic and mock have no tool-calling adapter; agent turns are not streamed; tool-calling quality depends on the selected model and is exercised by tests against a scripted server only.
Text-only modality; image/audio modalities route as MODALITY_UNSUPPORTED.
Remote-provider behaviour is verified with gating tests only; live remote evaluation is blocked on credentials (BLK-LLM-001).
